lessons.text: In the AP mailbox at /mail, open the vendor's latest email that actually has an invoice attachment and verify the attachment before downloading; skip follow-up/reminder emails without attachments.
Before recording a bill, use ERP API GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number>; an empty result confirms no duplicate bill exists.

To record a new bill in /erp, sign in with ERP_USER/ERP_PASSWORD secrets, click 'Record a new bill', fill the form fields Vendor, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Due Date, Total Amount, and Description, then click 'Save bill'.

On the bill page, set the Payment date field to the invoice due date and click 'Schedule payment'; for invoices ≥ INR 50,000, the system automatically routes for Finance Manager approval before the status becomes 'Payment scheduled'.

After processing, send a confirmation email via /mail/compose to priya.nair@kestrel.in containing vendor, invoice number, amount, bill ID, and payment date/status; verify it appears in the AP mailbox Sent folder.
